what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4658 Iraqi refugees in the United States, 1.7% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in periods from 1983 to 2025, and an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Iraq from 1983 to 1988.
It also records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory from 1983 to 1992 and in 1995 and 1996.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 1058 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 25384, at the end of 1997.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1994 to 2001 and 2006, and the figure was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
